title: War Prime
extract:
War Prime is the Primed variant of Hunhow's  War heavy blade, sporting increased Damage, Critical Multiplier, and Status Chance.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Impact damage.
Every hit on enemies that are not ragdolled procs an  Impact status effect.
Stance slot has  polarity, matches  Cleaving Whirlwind and  Tempo Royale stances.
Innate  polarity.
Advantages over other Melee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
High crit chance (26.00%)
High total damage (270)
Very high damage × attack speed (389.21)
Above average block angle (55°)
Above average follow through (0.6x)
Very high attack range (3.20 m)
High status chance (32.00%)
Very high crit multiplier (3.20x)

High total damage (500)

Acquisition
War Prime is acquired upon crafting Hunhow's Trinket, which can be purchased from Hunhow in Pontis Tower after Jade Shadows: Constellations with 12  Emerald Talent and 12  Crimson Talent, awarded from the Uranus Proxima. It comes with a Weapon Slot and a pre-installed  Orokin Catalyst.

Notes
War Prime cannot be sold for  Credits nor traded, and only one copy of Hunhow's Trinket or War Prime can be owned.

Trivia
War Prime is the third Primed weapon of  Sentient origin, after  Vadarya Prime and  Venato Prime.
Devstream 196 hinted a "secret", which would likely be War Prime as it was never announced prior to its implementation and its information is deliberately obscured in patch notes.
